scripts.test: pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/shared build && node --test scripts/api.test.mjs && pnpm -r --filter '!@app-skeleton/api' --if-present test && pnpm api test
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/shared build && eslint . && prettier --check . && node scripts/api.mjs lint --if-fastapi
scripts.format: prettier --write . && pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/shared build && eslint . --fix && node scripts/api.mjs format --if-fastapi
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/design-tokens check && pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/shared build && pnpm api build && pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/design-tokens check && pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/shared build && pnpm api typecheck && pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/app typecheck && pnpm --filter @app-skeleton/web typecheck
